Surge AI is a human-data platform for labeling, RLHF/SFT data collection, rubrics, and evaluation. This OpenAPI documents the REST endpoints used by the official surge-python SDK (https://github.com/surge-ai/surge-python), covering projects, tasks, and teams. Authentication uses API key Basic auth via the SURGE_API_KEY.
